|gr1= Mission Information

|descr= Finish the mission. If the server is set to run persistent mission, [[failMission]] will not end the mission when last player gets kicked to the lobby. Use [[endMission]] to end the mission.

The end type can be:
* "CONTINUE" - this is default type, basically an alias to do nothing
* "KILLED"
* "LOSER"
* "END1"
* "END2"
* "END3"
* "END4"
* "END5"
* "END6"

'''Mission saves won't be deleted'''.<br><br>

{{Feature|arma3|To maintain Arma 3 visual style, it is recommended to use [[BIS_fnc_endMission]] instead.}}

|s1= [[failMission]] endtype

|p1= endtype: [[String]]
|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>failMission "LOSER";</sqf>

|seealso= [[missionEnd]] [[endMission]] [[forceEnd]]
